# A TABLE-FOOTBALL TABLE SEEN FROM ABOVE. Five rods across the table -- the "=" handles poke
# out through the side walls -- each rod a row of men (letters, one team per rod) evenly
# spaced along it; the ball "o" lies in one of the gaps between the rods; the goal mouths are
# the holes in the two end walls. A rod shuffles sideways until one of its men stands in the
# ball's column: the short way if it fits, otherwise the long way round, and not at all if
# both ways would push a man off the table. A rod with a man already in the ball's column
# stays where it is. The caption counts the rods that move. ~12 % of clues say "0 shuffle".
#
# Every table is built role by role, so one picture always carries: a rod already on the ball
# (H), a jammed rod that cannot reach although it could still edge closer (n), another that
# cannot reach (N), a mover that goes the SHORT way although the far end has more room (R), a
# mover that has to go the LONG way round (X), and a mover heading away from the ball's side.
FB = (" +----------      ----------+ \n"
      "=|A-----A-----A-----A-----A-|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|--B------B------B------B--|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|-----A-------A-------A----|=\n"
      " |      o                   | \n"
      "=|-B--------B--------B------|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|-A-------A-------A-------A|=\n"
      " +----------      ----------+ \n"
      "2 shuffle")


def rod(r, W, b, want):
    """A rod (offset, spacing, men, span, shift, flags) playing the wanted part, or None."""
    I = W - 4
    for _ in range(9):
        g = r.randint(6, 9)
        k = (I - 1) // g + 1                       # a full rod: less slack than one spacing
        if want in "HRM" and r.random() < 0.75:
            k -= 1                                 # a rod with room to spare
        sp = (k - 1) * g
        if k < 3 or sp >= I:
            continue
        m = I - sp
        s0 = r.randrange(m)
        for j in range(m):
            o = 2 + (s0 + j) % m
            q = (b - o) % g
            if q + q == g:
                continue                           # a dead heat: never shipped
            lg = o - 2                             # spare room at the left-hand end
            rg = W - 3 - o - sp                    # spare room at the right-hand end
            if not q:
                if want == "H":
                    return (o, g, k, sp, 0, 0)     # a man already in the ball's column
                continue
            a, c = (q, q - g) if q + q < g else (q - g, q)
            d = a if (rg >= q if a > 0 else lg >= g - q) else (
                c if (rg >= q if c > 0 else lg >= g - q) else 0)
            if not d:
                if want == "N" or (want == "n" and lg > 0 < rg):
                    return (o, g, k, sp, 0, 0)     # jammed: it cannot reach either way
                continue
            # the two readings one demo alone would suggest -- "it slides the way it has more
            # room" and "it slides towards the ball's side" -- are refuted by these flags
            f = 4 * ((d > 0) != (rg >= lg) and rg >= q and lg >= g - q) + \
                2 * ((d > 0) != (b > o + sp // 2))
            if want == "M" or (want == "R" and d == a and f & 4) or (want == "X" and d == c):
                return (o, g, k, sp, d, f)
    return None


def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    z = r.random() < 0.12                          # 12 % of tables have nothing to shuffle
    for att in range(200):
        W = r.randint(30, 36)                      # full line width, handles included
        I = W - 4                                  # playing width between the side walls
        b = r.randrange(2, W - 2)                  # the ball's column
        n = 0 if z else r.choice((2, 2, 3))        # rods that shuffle
        want = ["H", "n", "N", "N", "N"] if z else ["H", "n", "R", "X"] + ["M"] * (n - 2)
        for _ in range(9):
            r.shuffle(want)
            if z or len({i % 2 for i, u in enumerate(want) if u in "RXM"}) > 1:
                break                              # the movers are never all from one team
        R = [rod(r, W, b, u) for u in want]
        if None in R:
            continue
        if not z and not [1 for _, _, _, _, d, f in R if d and f & 2]:
            continue                               # a mover heading away from the ball's side
        a = (I - 6) // 2
        wall = " +" + "-" * a + " " * 6 + "-" * (I - 6 - a) + "+ "
        P = [wall]
        y = r.randrange(4)
        for i, (o, g, k, sp, d, f) in enumerate(R):
            row = ["-"] * I
            for j in range(k):
                row[o - 2 + j * g] = "AB"[i % 2]
            P.append("=|" + "".join(row) + "|=")
            if i < 4:
                e = [" "] * I
                if i == y:
                    e[b - 2] = "o"
                P.append(" |" + "".join(e) + "| ")
        P.append(wall)
        if r.random() < 0.5:
            P = [y[::-1] for y in P]               # the same table seen from the other side
        return "\n".join(P) + "\n" + str(n) + " shuffle"
    return FB
solve:
def solve(clue):
    L = clue.split("\n")
    T = L.pop()                                    # the "<n> shuffle" caption, copied through
    W = len(L[0])
    b = max(y.find("o") for y in L)                # the ball's column
    E = []
    for y in L:
        m = [i for i, x in enumerate(y) if "A" <= x <= "Z"]
        if m:
            o = m[0]
            g = m[1] - o
            q = (b - o) % g                        # the shift to the right that reaches the ball
            fr = q <= W - 3 - m[-1]                # nobody pushed off the right-hand side
            fl = g - q <= o - 2                    # nobody pushed off the left-hand side
            if not q:
                d = 0                              # a man is already in the ball's column
            elif q + q < g:
                d = q if fr else (q - g if fl else 0)
            else:
                d = q - g if fl else (q if fr else 0)
            x = ["-"] * (W - 4)
            for i in m:
                x[i - 2 + d] = y[i]
            y = "=|" + "".join(x) + "|="
        E.append(y.rstrip())
    return "\n".join(E) + "\n" + T
